message.content: {"query_id": "T01", "candidates": [{"candidate_id": "DKS", "facts": [{"paper_uid": "W4415426565", "quote": "A multiscale numerical model, integrating the macroscopic finite element model and the microscopic cellular automaton model, is developed to simulate temperature field distribution and solidification microstructure of IN718 nickel-based superalloy during wire arc additive manufacturing (WAAM).", "statement": "该研究构建了耦合宏观有限元与微观元胞自动机的多尺度模型，用于模拟IN718镍基高温合金在电弧增材制造中的温度场与凝固组织。"}, {"paper_uid": "W4225151279", "quote": "A two-relaxation-time lattice Boltzmann model is proposed to simulate melt flows and free surface dynamics in an EBSM additive manufacturing process. The model also describes the dynamics of solid-liquid phase change and heat transfer, and it is validated by several simulations of classical benchmarks.", "statement": "该研究提出双松弛时间格子玻尔兹曼模型，模拟电子束选区熔化增材制造中的熔池流动、自由表面动力学以及固液相变与传热，并用经典基准算例进行验证。"}], "rationale": "若需在镍基合金增材制造中耦合宏观热场与微观组织演化，该候选人的多尺度与介观模拟方法可作为物理约束建模的互补假设；但材料体系与工艺（WAAM/EBSM）同目标需求存在差异，需验证迁移性。", "unknowns": "需了解其是否掌握钛合金或激光粉末床数据、模型代码与实验验证条件，以及当前合作意愿与数据共享许可。"}, {"candidate_id": "TG", "facts": [{"paper_uid": "W4411254318", "quote": "This paper compiles the mechanical properties of four materials—Ti6Al4V, 17-4PH, 304 stainless steel, and 316 stainless steel under both monotonic tensile loading and low-cycle fatigue conditions from published literatures. It examines the effects of anisotropy, surface treatment, heat treatment, and other post-processing methods on the mechanical properties of AM metals.", "statement": "该综述汇编了Ti6Al4V等四种增材制造金属在单调拉伸与低周疲劳下的力学性能，并考察各向异性、表面处理与热处理等后处理的影响。"}], "rationale": "若建模需将工艺—后处理与力学性能关联，该综述整理的本构与疲劳数据可作为条件性参考；但其为文献综述，未提供原始实验数据或物理约束模型，适用性需另行验证。", "unknowns": "需确认其是否拥有原始力学测试数据、钛合金增材实验条件及参与物理信息建模的意愿。"}, {"candidate_id": "FF", "facts": [{"paper_uid": "W4387951905", "quote": "To overcome these issues, in this work, a novel deep neural network architecture is proposed that includes HEA manufacturing routes as input features. The manufacturing routes, i.e., as-cast and laser additive manufactured samples, are transformed into the One-Hot encoder.", "statement": "该研究提出将高熵合金制造路线（铸态与激光增材制造）作为输入特征并采用独热编码的深度神经网络架构，以区分不同工艺路径。"}, {"paper_uid": "W4416057019", "quote": "This review focuses on deposition architecture strategies in wire arc additive manufacturing (WAAM) of dissimilar alloys, providing an in-depth analysis of how precise microstructure regulation affects the type, size, and distribution of interfacial IMCs.", "statement": "该综述聚焦异种合金电弧增材制造的沉积结构策略，分析组织调控如何影响界面金属间化合物的类型、尺寸与分布。"}], "rationale": "若需数据驱动方法区分工艺路径并预测性能，该候选人的制造路线编码思路可作条件性借鉴；但高熵合金与黑箱预测不构成物理约束方法，异种合金综述亦非镍/钛模型验证。", "unknowns": "需了解其是否具备镍基或钛合金增材数据、物理约束建模经验及数据与代码共享意愿。"}], "exclusions": []}
